content: PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE holds row locks until transaction completion; long transactions and lock ordering require care. Current documentation resolves to PostgreSQL 18; upstream versioning policy lists five-year major support. Drizzle and Prisma document database transactions and conflict handling. A booking-capacity transaction is an application recommendation, not a selected architecture. Sources: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/explicit-locking.html https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/ https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/transactions https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/fundamentals/transactions .
